_comment: Locators of the Price window (PricePage), opened from the Add tool dropdown of the home page. Name -> selector, or an object with selector, description and heal (default true; false for elements that may legitimately be absent). Keys starting with _ are ignored.

test1Input.description: input of the TEST1 dropdown (bookings, PricePage.selectBookings)

test2Input.description: input of the TEST2 dropdown (days, PricePage.selectDays)

dropdownList.description: option list of the open TEST1/TEST2 dropdown (only there while open)

dropdownListItem.description: option OPTION of the open TEST1/TEST2 dropdown: the li whose p shows OPTION

rows.description: grid rows (a header row has role=row too)

test1Div.description: the TEST1 div of a Price grid cell: a div right inside the cell whose class contains model1 (PricePage.verifySelectionShown; searched inside the cell)

test2Div.description: the TEST2 div of a Price grid cell: a div right inside the cell whose class contains model2 (PricePage.verifySelectionShown; searched inside the cell)
